input.module_under_test: Application Service: Manages creator applications to campaigns. Creators submit applications with a content outline, estimated delivery date, and requested fee. The service enforces: creator role required, campaign must be active, application deadline not passed, requested fee within campaign min/max range, delivery date before content deadline, and no duplicate active applications. A fit_score is computed on submission. Brand owners can accept (deducting from remaining_budget) or reject applications. Creators can withdraw their own submitted applications. Status flow: submitted -> accepted/rejected/withdrawn.
input.existing_test_patterns: Tests use pytest-asyncio with an httpx AsyncClient hitting the FastAPI app. Fixtures create domain objects directly via SQLAlchemy (db_session.add + flush). A helper function _application_payload() builds valid JSON payloads with **overrides for negative cases. Assertions check HTTP status codes, JSON body fields, and error message substrings. Tests are grouped by operation with comment headers (SUBMIT APPLICATION, LIST CAMPAIGN APPLICATIONS, LIST MY APPLICATIONS, ACCEPT/REJECT, WITHDRAW). The conftest provides sample_creator, sample_brand, sample_admin fixtures with different UserRole values.

edge_cases_covered: Successful application submission returns 201 with correct fields
Requested fee out of campaign range returns 422
Duplicate application to same campaign returns 409
Brand owner can list campaign applications
Creator can list their own applications
Accept application sets status to accepted and records responded_at
Reject application sets status and stores rejection_reason

required_edge_cases: Role-based access: only creators can submit applications
Role-based access: only campaign owner can accept/reject
Accept/reject flow updates status and responded_at
Withdrawal only allowed for submitted applications
Fee validation against campaign min/max range
